title: Panel Discussion: Understanding the New Landscape for Energy Transition Geopolitics
gist: The text is a member-only video listing page, not a transcript: a 31-minute Giga Africa 2026 panel on energy-transition geopolitics featuring Benchmark's Caspar Rawles with the UK Department for Business and Trade, UNIDO and the EU Delegation to Morocco. The only substance is the description: EMEA's role, geopolitical risk, trade policy and the Lobito Corridor as drivers of battery/EV supply-chain collaboration with African countries.

insights.claim: The panel frames international partnerships, trade policies and the Lobito Corridor as active forces reshaping battery and EV supply chains and creating collaboration opportunities with African countries.
insights.speaker: Caspar Rawles, Chief Operating Officer, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Logistics corridors like Lobito are treated as policy instruments for routing African minerals toward Western value chains.
